subject.title: Bug: new-session composer scrolls too early with confusing thumb

question: Should this confirmed-looking Control UI ergonomics regression be prioritized for a small UI repair under the existing maintainer review label?
rationale: The bug has a narrow proposed boundary, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit owner decision before automated repair routing.

options.title: Sponsor a focused UI repair
options.body: Confirm the desired multiline height and scrollbar appearance, then land a narrow `/new` composer change with browser before/after proof.

options.title: Defer after visual verification
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation if the current design is intentional or the reported rendering cannot be reproduced on supported browsers.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a focused UI repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the desired multiline height and scrollbar appearance, then land a narrow `/new` composer change with browser before/after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent composer-adjacent Control UI work makes this the best available routing candidate, although ownership evidence is limited.
